themes.label: Decrees
themes.rationale: The text is a formal resolution of the city of Gonnoi regarding the appointment of a host for sacred ambassadors.
themes.quote: ἔδοξε τῆι πόλει τῆι Γοννέων θεωροδόκον ἑλέσθαι κατὰ τὸ ψήφισμα

themes.label: Honorific Inscriptions
themes.rationale: The text explicitly grants the status of proxenos to those who act as theorodokoi and mentions their goodwill and philanthropy.
themes.quote: ὑπάρχειμ μὲν αὐτοὺς ἤδη προξένους τοῦ δήμου τοῦ Ἀθηναίων

themes.label: Lists of Officials or Citizens
themes.rationale: The decree instructs that the names of the theorodokoi be recorded in the Metroon.
themes.quote: προσαποφέρειν εἰς τὸ Μητρῶιον ἐν τοῖς λόγοις τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν θεωροδοκούντων

themes.label: Sacred Laws and Rules
themes.rationale: The text regulates the reception of sacred ambassadors for major religious festivals such as the Eleusinia, Panathenaia, and Mysteries.
themes.quote: σπονδὰς τῶν τε Ἐλευσινίων καὶ Παναθηναίων καὶ Μυστηρίων

themes.label: Treaties and Agreements
themes.rationale: This decree establishes a formal diplomatic relationship (proxeny and theorodokia) between the city of Gonnoi and the city of Athens.
themes.quote: ὃ ἤνεγκαν οἱ θεωροὶ τῶν Ἀθηνα[ί]ων Σωσιγένης καὶ Ἀρχεπτόλεμος

themes.label: Registers and Catalogues
themes.rationale: The text mentions the systematic recording of names of theorodokoi in the Metroon archives.
themes.quote: προσαποφέρειν εἰς τὸ Μητρῶιον ἐν τοῖς λόγοις τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν θεωροδοκούντων πατρόθεν

themes.label: Stele
themes.rationale: The text specifies that the decree should be inscribed on a stone stele.

themes.label: Other Stone
themes.rationale: The text specifies that the material used for the inscription is stone.

themes.label: Fragmentary
themes.rationale: The end of the inscription is missing or damaged, as indicated by the brackets and ellipses in the transcription.
themes.quote: [ἂν] τούτων γινομένων οἵ τε φιλο[τίμως π]ρὸς τὴν πόλιν διακείμε[νοι φανεροὶ] καθιστῶνται

themes.label: Partial Reconstruction
themes.rationale: The text contains several restored words and phrases, indicated by square brackets.
themes.quote: [ἂν] τούτων γινομένων οἵ τε φιλο[τίμως π]ρὸς τὴν πόλιν διακείμε[νοι φανεροὶ] καθιστῶνται

rationale: The inscription is a decree from the city of Gonnoi in Thessaly, dating to the late 3rd century BC. It concerns the appointment of Nikaios, son of Aristokrates, as a theorodokos (host for sacred ambassadors) for the Athenians. The decree was proposed by Eukles, son of Eukles, of the Attic deme Potamos. It outlines the honors granted to those who host sacred ambassadors for the Eleusinian, Panathenaic, and Mystery festivals, including the status of proxenos. The text also specifies that the names of these hosts should be recorded in the Metroon in Athens and that the decree itself should be inscribed on a stone stele and placed in the temple of Athena in Gonnoi.
